observations: Photo 0 shows a cardboard shipping box for a BRÜHM gas cooker.
The model number BGC-6640IB is clearly printed on a white label on the side of the box.
The box specifies a 60x60 free-standing gas cooker in black.
A MANCAP (Standards Organisation of Nigeria) sticker is visible on the box.
The box is sealed with tape but shows some crushing and wear at the top edges.
The actual appliance is not visible in the photo.
